title: 第81章 两个女人的分寸，和聪明人的饭局
content_zh:
第81章 两个女人的分寸，和聪明人的饭局-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

顾清烟站在女装店门口。

林川身边，沈蔓挽着他的胳膊，没有松开。

她见过不少场面。

航班上，男人把婚戒摘下来塞进口袋。

贵宾厅里，两个女人前后脚出现，男人低头翻报纸。

但眼前这个女人，不属于那些场面。

顾清烟穿着黑色长裙，米白披肩搭在肩上，东西都由助理拎着。

她没有多余动作，只是停在那儿，商场里来往的人便自动绕开。

沈蔓第一反应不是吃醋。

是判断。

这个女人和林川之间，有项目，有利益，也有别人插不进去的默契。

顾清烟先开口。

“林总，不介绍一下？”

林川把手里的购物袋换到另一边。

“顾清烟，顾氏负责人，也是张江项目的重要合作方。”

他转向沈蔓。

“沈蔓。”

没有前缀。

沈蔓先伸手。

“顾小姐，你好。”

顾清烟和她碰了下手。

“沈小姐。”

两人很快分开。

顾清烟看见沈蔓手里的袋子，里面露出两双熊猫拖鞋。

在这片高级女装区里，那两双拖鞋有点突兀。

“刚买完东西？”

沈蔓笑了笑。

“准备搬新家，买点小东西。杯子、拖鞋、餐具，乱七八糟一堆。”

“挺好。”

顾清烟点了下头。

“上海能有个自己的落脚地，比住酒店踏实。”

这句话不重。

沈蔓却听懂了。

她没有急着接话，也没有装熟。

林川看了下时间。

“你也来买东西？”

顾清烟往身后的店抬了下手。

“陪我妈挑礼服。她临时有事走了，我替她结账。”

助理往前半步。

“顾总，司机到地库了。”

顾清烟嗯了一声，又看向林川。

“张江那边的事，我听顾城讲了。恭喜。”

“还没到恭喜的时候。”

林川语气很淡。

“项目签了，后面才是真麻烦。”

顾清烟接得很快。

“麻烦也分人。有的人遇上麻烦，开始找门。有的人遇上麻烦，开始搭门。”

她说完，看向沈蔓。

“沈小姐，有空来顾氏坐坐。我和林总是很好的朋友。”

沈蔓笑得得体。

“谢谢顾小姐，有机会一定去。”

顾清烟没有再停。

“那不打扰你们逛街。”

她转身离开。

助理跟在后面，几个纸袋轻轻碰在一起。

等人走远，沈蔓才松开林川的胳膊。

“她很厉害。”

林川接过她手里的袋子。

“嗯，确实挺厉害。”

Chapter 81 The propriety of two women and the dinner party of a smart man - "Rebirth 2000: I broke the agreement and became rich"

Gu Qingyan stood in front of the women's clothing store.

Next to Lin Chuan, Shen Man held his arm and did not let go.

She has seen many scenes.

On the flight, the man took off his wedding ring and stuffed it into his pocket.

In the VIP room, two women appeared one after another, and the man lowered his head to read the newspaper.

But the woman in front of me does not belong to those scenes.

Gu Qingyan was wearing a long black dress, with an off-white shawl draped over her shoulders, and her assistant was carrying everything.

She didn't make any unnecessary moves, she just stopped there and people in the mall automatically avoided her.

Shen Man's first reaction was not jealousy.

It's judgment.

There are projects, interests, and a tacit understanding between this woman and Lin Chuan that others cannot interfere with.

Gu Qingyan spoke first.

"Mr. Lin, why don't you introduce me?"

Lin Chuan moved the shopping bag in his hand to the other side.

"Gu Qingyan, the person in charge of the Gu family, is also an important partner in the Zhangjiang project."

He turned to Shen Man.

"Shen Man."

No prefix.

Shen Man stretched out his hand first.

"Hello, Miss Gu."

Gu Qingyan touched her hands.

"Miss Shen."

The two soon separated.

Gu Qingyan saw two pairs of panda slippers in the bag in Shen Man's hand.

In this haute couture area, those two pairs of slippers were a bit out of the ordinary.

"Just finished shopping?"

Shen Man smiled.

"I'm going to move to a new house and buy some small things. Cups, slippers, tableware, it's all a mess."

"Very good."

Gu Qingyan nodded.

"Having my own place to stay in Shanghai is more practical than staying in a hotel."

This sentence is not serious.

But Shen Man understood.

She didn't rush to answer, nor did she pretend to be mature.

Lin Chuan checked the time.

"Are you here to buy something too?"

Gu Qingyan raised her hand towards the store behind her.

"I accompanied my mother to choose a dress. She left temporarily because of something, and I paid for her."

The assistant took a half step forward.

"Mr. Gu, the driver has arrived at the basement."

Gu Qingyan hummed and looked at Lin Chuan again.

"I heard from Gu Cheng about the matter in Zhangjiang. Congratulations."

"It's not time to congratulate you yet."

Lin Chuan's tone was very calm.

"Once the project is signed, the real trouble will come later."

Gu Qingyan picked up quickly.

"Trouble is divided into people. Some people are in trouble and start looking for help. Some people are in trouble and start looking for help."

After she finished speaking, she looked at Shen Man.

"Ms. Shen, come and sit with Gu's when you have time. Lin and I have always been very good friends."

Shen Man smiled appropriately.

"Thank you, Miss Gu. I will definitely go if I have the chance."

Gu Qingyan didn't stop.

"Then I won't disturb your shopping."

She turned and left.

The assistant followed behind, and several paper bags touched each other lightly.

After the people walked away, Shen Man let go of Lin Chuan's arm.

"She's awesome."

Lin Chuan took the bag in her hand.

"Well, it's really impressive."
